137.1: And when Jesus was baptized, immediately he went up from the water, and behold, the heavens were opened to him,
137.2: and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove and coming to rest on him
137.3: and behold, a voice from heaven said,
137.4: “This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased.”
137.5: Go therefore and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,
137.6: teaching them to observe all that I have commanded you.
137.7: And behold, I am with you always, to the end of the age.”
137.8: There is one body and one Spirit—just as you were called to the one hope that belongs to your call—
137.9: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,
137.10: one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in all.
